subject: General Science

questions.q: Rutherford’s $\alpha$-particle scattering experiment led to the discovery of which of the following?
questions.explain: Rutherford's alpha-particle scattering experiment demonstrated that most of an atom's mass and its positive charge are concentrated in a tiny central region, leading to the discovery of the atomic nucleus.
